name: zmodel_display_shutdown
description: zModel_Display::Shutdown shuts down material buffers, releases the display-instance pool when allocated, resets display-pool globals, and returns zero.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x475fa0 calls zModel_MatlBuffer::Shutdown, checks g_zModel_DiPoolCapacity, calls zModel_Display::Reset for an allocated pool, frees g_zModel_DiPoolBase, clears display-pool pointer/capacity/in-use count, sets g_zModel_DiPoolFreeHeadIndex to -1, and returns zero.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x475fa0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same material shutdown, display reset/free, global resets, and zero return.
The dependency frontier for 0x475fa0 has no visible functional-verification blockers after accepting zModel_MatlBuffer::Shutdown, zModel_Display::Reset, and the free provider.
The native zmodel_display_shutdown_smoke reaches Shutdown through ShutdownThunk and verifies display-pool and material-pool globals are fully reset.
